player_prompt.intro:
Nge ujile Mubandi {player_id} ({role}) mu joga ya Matching Pennies ya mavu {num_rounds}.
- Ku mavu yonse, tala [heads] kapwa [tails] (kapwa [h], [t]).
- Ikiwa kubandi kwako kuhaka na kubandi kwa kambundi wako, Mubandi 0 ujile wina mavu ao; kamba Mubandi 1 ujile wina.
Vutula kubandi kwako mu njila ya '[heads]' kapwa '[tails]'.

message.round_match: Mubandi 0 yalunda {choice0}; Mubandi 1 yalunda {choice1}. Haka -> Mubandi 0 ujile wina
message.round_mismatch: Mubandi 0 yalunda {choice0}; Mubandi 1 yalunda {choice1}. Kamba haka -> Mubandi 1 ujile wina.
